title: First-party apps and tools
description: Defines the distinction between apps (shipped in this binary) and tools (external repositories).
body: A **tool** is another repository: its frontend is served out of its own checkout, its Rust core is a child process the shell spawns and talks to over the standard streams. An **app** ships inside the orchestrator: its frontend is an extra entry point in this repo's own Vite config, its Rust half a module right here, reached over transport B and dispatched by call() below — no child process, no broker in between.
